title: Slaves Built the Pyramids... or Did They?
description:
Slaves built the pyramids... or did they? Aliens, helicopters and stargates on one side.
On the other: a horse, a buried wall, and work gangs who signed the stones "Friends of Khufu."

In 1968, Erich von Däniken's "Chariots of the Gods?" said ancient astronauts had visited Egypt, and his followers found more "clues": the Abydos "helicopter", the Dendera "light bulb", the Saqqara "glider", the pyramid as a power plant or a stargate aimed at Orion. Then archaeology answered: the builders' own tombs at Giza (found in 1990), the gangs' painted names, and the Diary of Merer, the oldest inscribed papyri ever found, logging limestone boats to Giza. And the king? His sarcophagus was found empty, and later Pyramid Texts promise him a staircase to the sky. So what do you think the pyramids really were?

- Pyramid Texts (Unas, c. 2350 BC), tr. R. O. Faulkner (1969), J. P. Allen (2005)
